## Context

- D148 ruling 2 says the priority is re-evaluated at every loop boundary and the result is committed even when nothing changes. The project applies it by hand today; the mob-defaults template, the product manager charter and the loop runner do not mention it, so a new mob would not get it and a loop could pull the next card on a stale order.
- Card 208 gives the runner a retro command and a re-rank command; this card makes the re-rank step a gate (no committed note, no next pull) and puts the rule where every mob starts from.
- Left to other cards: 208 (the runner gaps), 209 to 211 (the MD findings) and any change to how Ready is ranked.
- The change records in mob-defaults with a reference to D148, red test first (D137).
